```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
DefaultAssay(STO)  <- "integrated"
STO.sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(STO)
STO.sce1 <- slingshot(STO.sce, clusterLabels = 'ident', reducedDim = "UMAP", start.clus = "(C2) ProfTroph", allow.breaks = FALSE)
```

```{r}
slo <- SlingshotDataSet(STO.sce1)
slo
```

```{r}
Curves <- slingCurves(STO.sce1)
Curve1XY <- data.frame(X = Curves$Lineage1$s[,1], Y = Curves$Lineage1$s[,2])
Curve2XY <- data.frame(X = Curves$Lineage2$s[,1], Y = Curves$Lineage2$s[,2])
STO$pseudotime1 <- STO.sce1$slingPseudotime_1
STO$pseudotime2 <- STO.sce1$slingPseudotime_2
```

```{r}
inverted_colors <- rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, 'Spectral')[-6])(100))
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(STO, features = "pseudotime1", pt.size = 1, cols = inverted_colors) +
    geom_path(data = Curve1XY, aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, linetype = "dashed", 
              arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "inches")))

FeaturePlot(STO, features = "pseudotime2", pt.size = 1, cols = inverted_colors) +
    geom_path(data = Curve2XY, aes(x = X, y = Y), size = 1, linetype = "dashed", 
              arrow = arrow(type = "closed", length = unit(0.2, "inches")))
```


```{r}
counts <- as.matrix(STO@assays$RNA@counts)
filt_counts <- counts[rowSums(counts > 5) > ncol(counts)/100, ]
BPPARAM <- BiocParallel::bpparam()
BPPARAM$workers <- 7
sce <- fitGAM(filt_counts,
                sds=slo3,
                nknots = 4, sce = TRUE, verbose=TRUE)
```

```{r}
assoRes_STO <- associationTest(sce, lineages = TRUE)
write.csv(assoRes_STO, file="assoRes_STO.csv")
```

```{r}
p.adjusted <- p.adjust(assoRes_STO$pvalue, method = "fdr")
assoRes_STO$adjustedPValue <- p.adjusted
significantGenes <- assoRes_STO[which(assoRes_STO$adjustedPValue < 0.05), ]
write.csv(significantGenes, file="assoRes_STO.significantGenes.csv")
```


***Export direction***
```{r}
library(dplyr)

# Assuming you have the 'waldstat' in the 'sce' object
waldstat_df <- as.data.frame(rowData(sce)$waldStat) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene")

smoothers <- predictSmooth(sce, gene = rownames(sce), nPoints = 100)
direction_df <- smoothers %>%
    group_by(gene, lineage) %>%
    arrange(time) %>%
    summarize(direction = case_when(
        all(diff(yhat) > 0) ~ "increasing",
        all(diff(yhat) < 0) ~ "decreasing",
        TRUE ~ "mixed"
    )) %>%
    ungroup()

# Join direction_df with waldstat_df
output_df <- direction_df %>%
    left_join(waldstat_df, by = "gene")

# Write the output to a file
write.csv(output_df, "output_file.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r}
increasing_genes <- direction_df %>% filter(direction == "increasing")
decreasing_genes <- direction_df %>% filter(direction == "decreasing")
write.csv(increasing_genes, "increasing_genes.STO.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(decreasing_genes, "decreasing_genes.STO.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

**heatmap of all***
```{r}
startRes <- startVsEndTest(sce,l2fc = log2(1))
```

```{r}
order <- order(startRes$waldStat, decreasing = TRUE)
startRes200 <- names(sce)[order[1:250]]
logcounts_matrix <- assays(STO.sce3)$logcounts
setdiff(startRes200, rownames(logcounts_matrix))
valid_startRes200 <- startRes200[startRes200 %in% rownames(logcounts_matrix)]
specific_logcounts <- logcounts_matrix[valid_startRes200, ]
specific_logcounts_matrix <- as.matrix(specific_logcounts)
to_plot <- specific_logcounts_matrix
ptime <- STO.sce3$slingPseudotime_1
ptime_order <- colnames(to_plot)[order(ptime)]
lineage_cells <- colnames(STO.sce3)[!is.na(ptime)]


annotations <- colData(STO.sce)[lineage_cells, 
                            c("slingPseudotime_1", 
                              "ident")] %>% 
    as.data.frame()

cluster_colorsSTO<-c("(C0) IntTroph" = "#A6CEE3", "(C1) Areola-2" = "#FF7F00", "(C2) ProfTroph" = "#4DAF4A", "(C3) Areola-3" = "#984EA3", "(C4) Areola-1" = "#A65628")

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = annotations, col=list(ident=c("(C0) IntTroph" = "#A6CEE3", "(C1) Areola-2" = "#FF7F00", "(C2) ProfTroph" = "#4DAF4A", "(C3) Areola-3" = "#984EA3", "(C4) Areola-1" = "#A65628"), show_legend = TRUE))
```

***Heatmap of both trajectories***
```{r}
ptime <- slingPseudotime(STO.sce3)
avg_ptime <- rowMeans(ptime, na.rm = TRUE)
column_annotations <- data.frame(pseudotime = avg_ptime)
cluster_identities <- STO.sce3$ident
column_annotations <- data.frame(
    pseudotime = avg_ptime,
    ident = cluster_identities
)
specific_colors <- list(
    pseudotime = colorRamp2(c(min(avg_ptime), max(avg_ptime)), c("blue", "red")),
    ident = c(
        "(C0) IntTroph" = "#A6CEE3", 
        "(C1) Areola-2" = "#FF7F00", 
        "(C2) ProfTroph" = "#4DAF4A", 
        "(C3) Areola-3" = "#984EA3", 
        "(C4) Areola-1" = "#A65628"
    )
)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = column_annotations, col = specific_colors)
```


```{r}
library(colorRamp2)
Heatmap(to_plot,
        column_order = order(avg_ptime),  # Sort columns by pseudotime
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        show_row_names = TRUE, 
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
        top_annotation = ha, 
        na_col = "#0505A6",  
        use_raster = TRUE, 
        raster_by_magick = TRUE, 
        raster_magick_filter = "Bessel", 
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5), 
                         c("#0505A6",  "#00FFFF", "#02F002","#ADFF2F", "#FFFF00","#FFA500", "#FF0000"))
)

```

***Heatmap of single trajectories***

```{r}
traj1 <- read.csv("traj1.csv")
index_order <- order(traj1$waldStat, decreasing = TRUE)
traj1 <- traj1[index_order, ]
top_500_genes <- head(traj1$gene, 500)
logcounts_matrix <- assays(STO.sce3)$logcounts
missing_genes <- setdiff(top_500_genes, rownames(logcounts_matrix))
length(missing_genes) # This will tell you how many genes are missing
missing_genes
valid_genes <- intersect(top_500_genes, rownames(logcounts_matrix))
specific_logcounts <- logcounts_matrix[valid_genes, ]
specific_logcounts_matrix <- as.matrix(specific_logcounts)
```

```{r}
to_plot <- specific_logcounts_matrix
ptime <- STO.sce3$slingPseudotime_1
ptime_order <- colnames(to_plot)[order(ptime)]
lineage_cells <- colnames(STO.sce3)[!is.na(ptime)]
```


```{r}
specific_colors <- list(
    pseudotime = colorRamp2(c(min(avg_ptime), max(avg_ptime)), c("white", "#FF007F")),
    ident = c(
        "(C0) IntTroph" = "#A6CEE3", 
        "(C1) Areola-2" = "#FF7F00", 
        "(C2) ProfTroph" = "#4DAF4A", 
        "(C3) Areola-3" = "#984EA3", 
        "(C4) Areola-1" = "#A65628"
    ))

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = column_annotations, col = specific_colors)
```

```{r}
Heatmap(to_plot,
        column_order = order(avg_ptime),  # Sort columns by pseudotime
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        show_row_names = TRUE, 
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 3),
        top_annotation = ha, 
        na_col = "#0505A6",  
        use_raster = TRUE, 
        raster_by_magick = TRUE, 
        raster_magick_filter = "Bessel", 
        col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5), 
                         c("#0505A6",  "#00FFFF", "#02F002","#ADFF2F", "#FFFF00","#FFA500", "#FF0000"))
)
```
